name: Xi'an High Voltage Apparatus Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an High Voltage Apparatus Research Institute Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides electrical inspection and testing services in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers professional technical services; type, performance, routine, and certificate tests; arbitration inspection; quality appraisement; and metrological verification of electrical equipment.
